user.title: Configure Mennekes AMTRON Wallbox
user.description:
Enter the details of your Mennekes AMTRON wallbox.
The wallbox must be reachable via HTTP on the specified API port.

data_description.api_port: HTTP API port for REST calls
data_description.price_per_kwh: Used for cost calculations. Enter it in your Home Assistant currency (Settings → System → General).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to update sensor values

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to wallbox. Check IP address, port, and network connectivity.
error.invalid_credentials: Authentication failed. Check the installer password.
error.timeout_connect: Connection timeout. Wallbox may be unreachable or slow to respond.
error.ssl_error: SSL error while connecting to the wallbox.
error.invalid_host: Invalid IP address or hostname format.
error.invalid_port: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
error.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.
